subject: Re: DeepFin — pricing & committed-use options (post-call recap)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-call recap + pricing questions / next steps

Hi Simon — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap from our side and a couple of follow-ups so we can quote an appropriate committed-use discount: 

Summary of discovery (what I captured):
- Current inference pattern: primarily chat completions for customer support and content generation; some batch embedding jobs for search.
- Current monthly tokens (approx): ~2.5M tokens/month (prod), spikes up to ~4M during campaigns.
- Near-term growth target: 6–10M tokens/month within 3–6 months as you roll out new automation.
- Primary success metrics: per-token cost target for budgeting, predictable latency, and data controls.

Pricing / qualification asks (so we can size discounts):
1) Target unit economics: is there a reference target for $/1M tokens you have in mind? (e.g., $700 / $900 / $1,200 per 1M)
2) Budget range: what monthly budget range are you comfortable committing to for the next 6–12 months?
3) Commitment window preference: 6mo vs 12mo vs 24mo (multi-year incentives available)
4) Any procurement/contracting constraints (PO, SSO, legal review timeline)

To make things concrete — high-level examples (illustrative only):
- Pay-as-you-go: $1,200 per 1M tokens
- 6-mo committed use (3M/mo min): $900 per 1M tokens (approx 25% off)
- 12-mo committed use (2M/mo min): $800 per 1M tokens (approx 33% off)
- 24-mo / multi-year: $700 per 1M tokens (with staggered billing and renewal incentives)

We also have a startup program that can stack an additional one-time credit + a % off for qualifying early-stage companies (we'll need basic validation info). I attached a short PDF with committed-use tiers and the startup validation form to this thread.

Next steps I propose:
- You reply with the three items above (target $/1M, budget range, preferred commitment window).
- If you want, we can schedule a 30-min pricing deep-dive with Ben (pricing lead) to walk the options and contract structure.

Thanks — I want to make sure we put a proposal that fits your unit economics rather than throwing a generic number.

Best,
Marissa Cole

From: Simon Park <simon.park@deepfin.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + pricing questions / next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful and aligns with what we discussed. Quick answers below: 

1) Target $/1M tokens: our budget model is aiming for ~$750–$900 per 1M tokens (we're aiming for ~ $800 target if we can get predictable latency and SLA).
2) Budget range: for Q1–Q2 we can commit to $8k–$12k/month (which maps to ~10–16M tokens at target price points depending on discount). We have flexibility to grow to $15–$20k/mo if the early rollout goes well.
3) Commitment window: we prefer a 12-month committed-use agreement if it gets us to ~$800 or lower per 1M tokens. 24-mo would be interesting if you can push to $700 and include termination protections.
4) Procurement: we require standard security addenda, SSO (SAML), and a PO. Legal turnaround is ~2–3 weeks once pricing is agreed.

We'd like to see an example term sheet with the tiered committed-use numbers + any startup credit stacking options. Also, any metrics on token consumption variance handling (bursting) would be helpful — we expect spikes during marketing pushes.

Happy to take the 30-min deep-dive tomorrow morning PST if Ben is available.

Cheers,
Simon Park
Head of Engineering
DeepFin
simon.park@deepfin.ai
